business_summary: M-Grass Ecology And Environment (Group) Co., Ltd. engages in the seed industry technology and ecological restoration businesses. M-Grass Ecology And Environment (Group) Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Inner Mongolia M-Grass Ecology and changed its name to M-Grass Ecology And Environment (Group) Co., Ltd. in February 2022. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Hohhot, China.
